fusions.name: Rehearsed Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a conjured mesh that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangle Tally
fusions.desc: Hauls a conjured mesh through every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave them [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Drilled Reach
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Tied by Habit
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 4 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
